role: XCTest suite for DataPurgeService ('Delete All My Data'): report booleans and summary copy, stubbed remote-deletion success/failure, conversation/facts/disclaimer clearing read back from disk, container sweep of unknown files and directories, removal of a settings file that is not the live one and the keep rule for the live one, unlistable and missing roots, UserDefaults sweep with the entitlement/migration/AppleLanguages keep rules, the biometric profile reset read from the settings file, the personal baseline reset, iCloud sync left off, the refusal while a recording is under way and the run when none is, and which collector and workout states count as recording. Each purge sweeps a temporary scope (temp directories, throwaway suites, temporary archive and baseline file) and takes the suite's own Stores, built from a fresh container with the conversation, facts and trail stores on temporary files (AppDependencies.current is never swapped); a separate test pins that PurgeScope.device names the real containers and suites.
state: savedSettings: UserSettings? / savedDisclaimer: Bool (per-test restore of SettingsManager.shared)
lazy appSuite, groupSuite, containers, scope, baselineTracker (on <group>/HRVBaseline.json), rawBackup (RawRRBackup in <group>/RRBackup), archive (built from the per-instance root and suite names)

lazy conversationStore, userFactsStore, breadcrumbStore (on files under the test's root) and stores (DataPurgeService.Stores from a fresh AppDependencies with those substitutes and an empty RecorderBox)
toplevel: Purge calls go through purge(remoteDeleted:scope:), which injects the suite's stores, deleteRemote (no real CloudKit zone deletion), the test's raw backup store (in the temporary App Group container) and baseline tracker, a recording answer of false and the temporary scope (or one a test builds from it); the two recording tests call purgeAllUserData directly with the same injections and their own recording answer.

units.does: Lazily builds the DataPurgeService.Stores every purge in the suite takes: a fresh AppDependencies() whose overrides hold the test's conversationStore and userFactsStore (files under the test's root, outside the swept containers), its breadcrumbStore (<root>/Breadcrumbs/active.json) and an empty RecorderBox, read through its purgeStores; every other store resolves to the app's live service. AppDependencies.current is never touched.

units.does: Per-test async tearDown: restores the saved settings (when captured) and the disclaimer flag, removes both throwaway suites' persistent domains and the temporary directory (a missing one is ignored).

units.does: Calls DataPurgeService.purgeAllUserData with the test's archive, the test's RawRRBackup (RRBackup in the temporary App Group container), the shared CloudKit sync and settings managers, the suite's stores (DataPurgeServiceTests.stores), the test's baseline tracker, recordingInProgress answering false (so the host app's collector and workout recorder are never consulted), a deleteRemote stub returning `remoteDeleted`, and the given scope or the test's temporary one; rethrows a refusal.
